clean_body: Peter, the GOP is trying to destroy democracy. | | | Peter, When first I decided to run for office, I never imagined that I would be running without knowing what my district looked like. Over the past weeks and months, it became clear that this may be my reality -- and the reality of candidates across the state trying to serve their communities. After the courts struck down three proposed maps here in Ohio, the Republican-controlled legislature held back-door meetings circumventing the legislative process to forcibly put in place unconstitutional maps. Not only that, we STILL don’t even know when our election will be. Legislative candidates were removed from the May 3rd primary ballot, and no one knows what will happen next. It is clear the GOP does not care about fair elections or representation. That’s why it is important for candidates like me to have a platform to speak on these issues and get elected. Without these decisions in place, there is a lot I don’t know in regards to my campaign plan. So what am I doing? I’m putting my head down, building my grassroots army, and fundraising my heart out -- one dollar at a time -- so that when the maps are decided, I'm ready to go. ---
| |
---
| | | [](https://j0l1y7h.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Ffb.watch%2Fc2UHLL835U%2F/1/0100017fd6c74b85-67f97957-55bd-4691-b80f-b4c44fdf6449-000000/2arkuOaxfUUsOmP_w8GdBQFFXKk=264)
---
|
---
| Yesterday morning, Judge David Franzen of Charlottesville was scheduled to have a press conference to call for the tearing down of a War Memorial in Orange on public land adjacent to courthouse property. When the citizens of Orange County caught wind of this they organized a protest that resulted in Judge Franzen cancelling the protest. Obviously, as their State Senator, and someone who has led the charge to preserve our history from Richmond to Charlottesville, _I wanted to join them._ While Judge Franzen held court inside, we peacefully gathered around the statue and made our demands heard. **The bench is no place to play politics, it is for dispensing justice.** Ultimately, the Board of Supervisors has the power to decide what happens to our statues on public lands, and based off their last election the voters of Orange County have made clear they want them to stay. **If Judge Franzen wants to play politics so badly, he should resign from the judiciary and run for office!**
---
| |
---
| [](https://j0l1y7h.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Ffb.watch%2Fc2X9_EkZb-%2F/1/0100017fd6c74b85-67f97957-55bd-4691-b80f-b4c44fdf6449-000000/o1LuJpKLawYzQ8KT8lPgb7Eo3F8=264)
---
| |
---
| As the Democrats try to jam through their agenda by any means, legal or illegal, people are looking for leadership ready to stand up for them. **I've been fighting to preserve our history for years.** [Earlier this year, I stood against the Charlottesville City Council, as they flagrantly violated the law and voted to destroy the statue of Robert E. Lee that has stood there for nearly 100 years.](https://j0l1y7h.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fthevirginiastar.com%2F2022%2F01%2F02%2Fstate-senator-reeves-supporting-lawsuit-over-decision-to-melt-charlottesville-lee-statue%2F/1/0100017fd6c74b85-67f97957-55bd-4691-b80f-b4c44fdf6449-000000/JhgFInisDzTqsPoEMHx6z9XlxX8=264) The Democrats have an office just a block from this statue in Orange - how come Abigail Spanberger hasn't said anything yet? I will always stand for the rule of law. We have elections for a reason, and I'm sick of watching Democrats lose elections and seek other means to force their will on our communities. That is why I am running for Congress. The Biden/Spanberger agenda doesn't reflect the will of the American people. [Over 70% of Americans think our country is on the wrong track.](https://j0l1y7h.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fwww.cnbc.com%2F2022%2F03%2F27%2Fbiden-job-approval-fall-to-lowest-point-amid-russia-and-inflation-worry.html/1/0100017fd6c74b85-67f97957-55bd-4691-b80f-b4c44fdf6449-000000/-LE72I-9LX8-nHsHubiHpUPv_Lc=264) _I'm the only person in this race with the experience to defeat Abigail Spanberger, and fight Joe Biden's radical agenda in Congress on Day One._ I'm asking for your vote on June 21st, so we can lead the charge to take back the House of Representatives in November, and get our country back on the right track! In Service,Sen. Bryce Reeves
---

Out of 435 members, [she is 8th in receiving Special Interest Group spending,](https://j0l1y7h.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fwww.axios.com%2Fhouse-candidates-fundraising-special-interest-74c8a8c6-371a-4509-8669-00b793acbc41.html/1/0100017fd6c74b85-67f97957-55bd-4691-b80f-b4c44fdf6449-000000/B5ZSzCTNXfAhb48XmtRjcmk9aOk=264) having received over $1.3 million dollars in spending so far this election! My special interest group has always remained the same - my constituents. Friend, I'm personally reaching out to my most engaged supporters (including you) with an urgent update:
My finance team just let me know we're still short of our fundraising goal for this quarter. This means that - in a matter of hours - we might have to close the books and submit a public fundraising report to the FEC that shows us behind where we thought we'd be.
**Friend, I am counting on your donation to get us back on track before it 's too late. **
Democrats missing goals like this is just what the Republican Party is betting on. With the Senate split 50-50, the GOP only needs to flip a single Senate seat to put Mitch McConnell back in charge - and the political ground here in Connecticut is giving them hope:
Republicans flipped a state legislative seat here just last year, and this month, national Republicans opened a campaign office in this state for the first time ever - with RNC Chairwoman and Trump apologist Ronna McDaniel personally paying a visit.
With Senate control on the line, Republicans will surely be looking for weakness. We cannot let them think - even for a moment - that we don't have what it takes to win this race. **The greatest way to show our strength, and prove to Mitch McConnell that this Senate seat won 't be an easy flip, is for every supporter reading this email to chip in whatever they can. **
**Can you please help me close our fundraising gap before midnight? Here 's the best link to give: [ https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/blumenthal-email](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1157-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)**
Thanks for stepping up when it's needed most.
Dick

subject: We can't put McConnell back in charge of the Senate
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JAY INSLEE FOR WASHINGTON (D)
body:
We can't afford to let either Washington go red.

| [](https://links.e.jayinslee.com/els/v2/gp3jhA-Xk8QV/OENJZ2xIZ3VIT25TU1EwT3NrbkY3S1ZFdFFSVnludXVWcTE4MVg4b2pKL3Yra3RGU0pDTHJIMktGZlJWeDBWZUxHN1dOOFhCNFhyTzdBNFk3QmhqZmQwV1dHZndtOFI1QXlXa2o3c1ZMQlE9S0/anZKR1oyYVR1dTczZXlGTkQyMThyakhnSXhTdExETHBmYTBlRGRQSUNkRT0S1) Friend -- Control of the Senate could come down to my friend Senator Patty Murray's seat right here in Washington. **National Republicans led by Mitch McConnell have rallied behind Sen. body:
Karen is the leader L.A. needs.

Team —

I was one of the first people to endorse Karen Bass to be Los Angeles' next mayor, and today, I want to explain why I'm so proud to back her historic campaign.

I've always been proud to call Karen a friend. And as a former mayor myself, I know what it takes to lead a city. I know with certainty that Karen has what it takes to do the job.

Los Angeles is a world-class city, and this local race will have national and international implications. Karen has always been an unwavering voice for progress in the halls of Congress and a champion in the fight for long-overdue reforms that put working people first. I know that Karen is the leader that L.A. needs right now.

Karen has a lead in the polls, and it's clear this grassroots campaign is something to be proud of; but, the bottom line is this is still anyone's race. Her billionaire opponent is on track to spend $20 million, and going up against spending like that will require serious resources.

**[Team, I'm personally reaching out today because I know Karen is the best choice to move the city of Los Angeles forward – but she needs our help. ## March 29, 2022

| |

|
---
| | |
## A Personal Note From Ed

"When you're surrounded by good people, people who share your values, you can suffer through and overcome any adversity." -Peggy McFarland
In the midst of sheer campaign insanity, I'm reminded why my team and I are suffering through this struggle. The most accurate description I've heard about electoral politics is NON-VIOLENT WAR. This electoral contest is bigger to our team than 'just another election.' Maybe it's not 'just another election' simply because most of us are new to the world of political campaigns. Or perhaps it's because we thoroughly believe we're in a knife-fight for the very soul of Idaho and America. Regardless of motive, a statewide campaign would test and try anyone.
Strength rejoices in the challenge! The Humphreys team accepted the challenge and rose to meet it head on. I'm deeply proud to be surrounded by dedicated and passionate Patriots. The last 10+ months of effort will be defined in a few short weeks. I'm astonished and inspired by the examples of countless people. Now we're watching in real time as all the work pays off in big ways. We are mobilized and working the whole state. Few things go as smoothly as I would like, but a campaign is the ultimate startup challenge: build out a large organization with hundreds of positions to coordinate with 100,000 Idahoans.
We have beat every bet against us thus far. We have overcome every obstacle; censorship, political trickery, endless deceit, false promises, and suppression "polls." Numerous political hacks have tried to set us up only to be outwitted every time. Still, I'm grateful for every bit of it. I'm even grateful for the many people I've encountered that sold their honor for a perceived political advantage because all of it made me a stronger candidate and a better leader.
All this to say; momentum is on our side now. While other candidates' posture and politick to trade a few votes back and forth, the Ed Humphreys campaign is getting everyone's attention. People throughout Idaho are wearing hats and shirts and sporting bumper stickers and yard signs. It's neat to witness but I'm not so arrogant as to think it has anything to do with me.
Personally, I'm just grateful to be a part of a movement. The legacy career politicians need to be retired and replaced by courageous and strong public servants. The political machinery built by corporate America won't be defeated without an intense fight. But that conflict will mold individuals into capable leaders who are worthy of success. There is no doubt in my mind that you'll see a number of the future leaders of this state who came up through the ranks on the Humphreys campaign. We are the tip of the spear. I look forward to seeing everyone on the other side of the Primary. It's an honor for my family and I to play a small role in something so much bigger than ourselves. I don't know what the result of this will be, but I know I can say that EVERY single member of the core Humphreys team is completely committed to victory on May 17th. I hope that our example will inspire many more individuals to get out of the stands and onto the field. We will give these career politicians a run for their money! -[Ed Humphreys](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001eo3hCDDm9HaAxILeHbOKheu0Le5IMunJI1hpxqwwyx_mn7dFU69EXTNH7PaH9cra946cCP-vEQVM0fzH5ylXxJ8OKitmP-g0wAO7B4YUNjRmapHDaxgKxRVn3Tk5l94s3p0WlO46cvgQm4KJJ6MQ0sC6_NTmisV_CwUujrEp-aKC29fTJ9fiAEliHtYaf6T5h4V-2nDTJPSUs95TrhhqqIq8ID_hjPLfXJjunj_BbuJTOPkLagTlnKmmbLYif4b5veeWE3kqpBW4i8TTbHFdbRI5V3cq73USLgmPKxW2kCAIWr_sHMII1zr3meLH52hIQXmImYBUxd3Y-gjB6Kz4StteSM8fy0a6q0UYR_vJG14MBskDuNMYD3tXBxzBdt2SKDBHsQPE3sbe-keTgx9BMJ2C56OnkwYvv4j1JSstb4I=&c=GNSUEaRTOf9klOPdf48j7T0ILe8opEOuzJrQbmO0eZFasVWIBORdgw==&ch=z0x5XPD22-xkmzZ242kuoMkOk1Ws_P0NEdZoi5eLqG0rwTAaJwtfnA==)

# Principles Above Politics
---
|
---
| |
We cannot solve problems with the same mentality that created them. The elitists measure success by growth. Growth in budgets, growth in the size of government. That growth is paid for by us, but it rarely benefits us.

clean_body: | | | | | | | March 29, 2022 | | | | | | A Personal Note From Ed "When you're surrounded by good people, people who share your values, you can suffer through and overcome any adversity." -Peggy McFarland In the midst of sheer campaign insanity, I'm reminded why my team and I are suffering through this struggle. The most accurate description I've heard about electoral politics is NON-VIOLENT WAR. This electoral contest is bigger to our team than 'just another election.' Maybe it's not 'just another election' simply because most of us are new to the world of political campaigns. Or perhaps it's because we thoroughly believe we're in a knife-fight for the very soul of Idaho and America. Regardless of motive, a statewide campaign would test and try anyone. Strength rejoices in the challenge! The Humphreys team accepted the challenge and rose to meet it head on. I'm deeply proud to be surrounded by dedicated and passionate Patriots. The last 10+ months of effort will be defined in a few short weeks. I'm astonished and inspired by the examples of countless people. Now we're watching in real time as all the work pays off in big ways. We are mobilized and working the whole state. Few things go as smoothly as I would like, but a campaign is the ultimate startup challenge: build out a large organization with hundreds of positions to coordinate with 100,000 Idahoans. We have beat every bet against us thus far. We have overcome every obstacle; censorship, political trickery, endless deceit, false promises, and suppression "polls." Numerous political hacks have tried to set us up only to be outwitted every time. Still, I'm grateful for every bit of it. I'm even grateful for the many people I've encountered that sold their honor for a perceived political advantage because all of it made me a stronger candidate and a better leader. All this to say; momentum is on our side now. While other candidates' posture and politick to trade a few votes back and forth, the Ed Humphreys campaign is getting everyone's attention. People throughout Idaho are wearing hats and shirts and sporting bumper stickers and yard signs. It's neat to witness but I'm not so arrogant as to think it has anything to do with me. Personally, I'm just grateful to be a part of a movement. The legacy career politicians need to be retired and replaced by courageous and strong public servants. The political machinery built by corporate America won't be defeated without an intense fight. But that conflict will mold individuals into capable leaders who are worthy of success. There is no doubt in my mind that you'll see a number of the future leaders of this state who came up through the ranks on the Humphreys campaign. We are the tip of the spear. I look forward to seeing everyone on the other side of the Primary. It's an honor for my family and I to play a small role in something so much bigger than ourselves. I don't know what the result of this will be, but I know I can say that EVERY single member of the core Humphreys team is completely committed to victory on May 17th. Every dollar counts for a grassroots funded campaign like ours as we prepare for every attack Rand Paul has planned to stop our movement.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220329?refcode=em20220329-1698&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&refcode2=1698_346206_wQh0mS&akid=1698%2E346206%2EwQh0mS)[**

We’re reaching a pivotal moment for our team (let me explain):[**
**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220329?refcode=em20220329-1698&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&refcode2=1698_346206_wQh0mS&akid=1698%2E346206%2EwQh0mS)
* **We are officially less than 50 days away from our primary election.** From here on out, it’s especially important we grow our fundraising and make sure we have the money we need to reach out to voters all across Kentucky and prepare for all the dark money Rand Paul’s friends are preparing to dump in this race.

* As of today, **we are just two days away** from our first FEC filing deadline this election year. This is a critical moment for us to show off the strength of our grassroots movement to turn Kentucky blue — we can’t afford to slow down our fundraising one bit.

* On top of everything, it was already recently reported that **an infamous conservative billionaire is funding a Super PAC** that was created for the sole purpose of attacking our campaign and protecting Rand Paul’s seat. We expect a flood of attack ads to start appearing in Kentucky soon after this quarter ends and we need to be ready to spread our people-first message.

[**That’s why we set a goal to raise $200,000 by midnight on Thursday to make sure we have the grassroots power to defeat Rand Paul this year. We’re hoping you and 1 other supporter from 18326 can chip in $5 today to help us reach our end-of-quarter goal.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220329?refcode=em20220329-1698&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&refcode2=1698_346206_wQh0mS&akid=1698%2E346206%2EwQh0mS)
**[DONATE $5 NOW →](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220329?refcode=em20220329-1698&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=24&refcode2=1698_346206_wQh0mS&akid=1698%2E346206%2EwQh0mS)**
Peter, we have a rare opportunity this year to make our politicians work for us.
For too long, Rand Paul has consistently ignored Kentuckians — he doesn’t care that hospitals are at max capacity from the rise in COVID cases, how long someone has been out of a job, or whether families can afford rent next week. He’s a politician who will say or do anything to get in the news, put the spotlight on himself and his conspiracy theories, and sell us out to big industries.
**But now, we have a historic chance to turn the tides of our future.** Thousands of Kentuckians from the hood to the holler are rising up with us to elect Charles Booker and send a working class champion to the U.S. Senate. Our campaign is gaining momentum, _but we need your support to make sure we post big numbers for our first FEC filing deadline and start this year off right._
[**Peter, if you can afford to give just $5, it’ll go a long way in helping us reach our goal so we can out-organize Rand Paul and hit our end-of-quarter goal this Thursday. We’re hoping you can show your support from 18326 and show the strength of our movement.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220329?refcode=em20220329-1698&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=25&refcode2=1698_346206_wQh0mS&akid=1698%2E346206%2EwQh0mS)
Every dollar counts especially now that we’re closing out the first quarter of an election year — we rely 100% on grassroots supporters like you to power this work.
Let’s do this,
Leo

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: ANOTHER defense budget increase
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
This is unacceptable, Peter.
#
Peter, the defense budget has increased TWICE in the last few months and now there could be yet another increase. Here’s what has happened.
Last year, Congress passed a $770 billion military budget. That was even higher than Trump’s last defense spending bill. I fought for a 10 percent cut in military spending from the year before. Instead, Congress wanted more giveaways to private defense contractors and military waste.
A few weeks ago, Congress allocated even MORE money to a bloated military budget. I voted No.
Now, this from just yesterday in _Politico_ :
[](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/11473?refcode=em20220329-1142&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=1142%2E420207%2ERTH8Y_)
$813,000,000,000 would be a significant increase over the current defense budget and tens of billions more than Trump’s last defense budget. It’s unconscionable spending, Peter. It’s a giveaway to defense corporations. And it’s wrong.
The Pentagon doesn't need this money — working people who can't afford child care, housing, and health care do.
[Will you fuel my continued fight to cut defense spending by 10 percent and invest in the people? Chip in $3 now to help me hit my end-of-quarter fundraising goal, so our fight remains strong against wasteful military spending that ONLY benefits private defense contractors.](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/11473?refcode=em20220329-1142&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=1142%2E420207%2ERTH8Y_)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/11473?refcode=em20220329-1142&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=1142%2E420207%2ERTH8Y_)**
So many lawmakers who balked at Build Back Better will vote for massive defense spending without a thought. And if this defense budget passes, it will set us on a path to spend at least $8 trillion on the Pentagon over the next decade. **Build Back Better would have cost us trillions less AND would have invested in health care, education, affordable housing, childcare, paid sick and family leave, fighting the climate crisis, and so much more.**
Congress could be doing the work of guaranteeing health care for everyone in this country, it could be ensuring workers get a raise and time off, and it could be passing transformative legislation to address the climate crisis. Those are the things I’m fighting for, because delivering for the people, our communities, and our planet is my job.
We cannot normalize massive defense budget increases. We cannot allow endless defense spending and giveaways to private defense contractors come before investments in the people.
[Support my fight to deliver for our communities, our people, and our planet with a $3 contribution to my campaign today. We must ensure Congress is working for the people, not defense corporations.](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/11473?refcode=em20220329-1142&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=1142%2E420207%2ERTH8Y_)
In solidarity,
Pramila

**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-footer?refcode=em20220329-1142-footer&t=23&refcode2=1142_420207_RTH8Y_&akid=1142%2E420207%2ERTH8Y_)**

| | Dear Friends,

| | Peter

I recently appeared on Political Coffee with Jeff Kropf to discuss my solutions for Oregon’s Fifth Congressional District and how I plan to unseat Democratic Congressman Kurt Schrader.

My vision is simple - I want my children and grandchildren to have the same opportunities that I did.
**It’s time for new leadership in Washington, D.C.**
**What We Discussed:**
* Socialist policies have eroded the American dream of life, liberty and the pursuit of happiness. I’m running to change that.

* Skyrocketing inflation, rising crime, rampant homelessness, and the politicization of our education system have all contributed to the current state of affairs. I’m running to restore Oregon’s economy.

* We are facing a serious drug epidemic that is destroying our communities and killing our youth. I’m running to change the status quo.

The full interview can be found on [Apple Podcasts](https://dipaolaforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=566d5a1c5a0aa7e5f5397f0e6&id=cd5c47f823&e=b369608f84), [Spotify](https://dipaolaforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=566d5a1c5a0aa7e5f5397f0e6&id=681878c63d&e=b369608f84), or [Transistor](https://dipaolaforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=566d5a1c5a0aa7e5f5397f0e6&id=f7c00f056e&e=b369608f84) beginning at 23:44. I’ve been fighting for you and for the truth since I first was elected to Congress in November 2006. Since then, the voters of Ohio’s 4th Congressional District have continued to put their faith in me and have sent me back for two-year stints ever since.

**I will never take the position I currently hold for granted**.

For as long as the folks I represent continue putting their faith in me, **I’ll keep fighting every single day to make America a better version of itself.**

body:
| Hi Peter — just checking in to make sure that you saw my Finance Director’s email. I want you to know how appreciative I am that supporters like you have got our back. I know we’ve said it a LOT lately, but _this deadline really is the most important one of our campaign so far_ , and the support we build now is going to set the tone for the rest of this race. ## Our founding fathers knew we needed the right to bear arms to defend ourselves against criminals and a totalitarian government. It is my solemn promise that I will not allow ANY infringement on our 2nd Amendment rights.

Government leftists whittle away at our right to bear arms through legislation and politically motivated prosecution.
Idaho needs a governor who will stand firm against any and all attempts to infringe upon our 2nd Amendment rights. Thanks to the efforts of dedicated legislators and citizens, Idaho has some of the best 2nd Amendment protections in the nation. subject: A ‘MAGA operation’ in Michigan?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq12022?refcode=email20220329&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq12022?refcode=email20220329&amount=28]
Team,
We emailed you recently about Donald Trump’s upcoming visit to Michigan. Well, things just got a bit more interesting.
Last night, Trump’s preferred candidate for Michigan Attorney General joined Steve Bannon for a conversation on the 2022 midterm elections – and if it wasn’t clear all eyes are on Michigan before, it certainly is now.
We listened to the whole conversation so that we can give you the CliffsNotes. The highlight? The revelation that Donald Trump is looking to turn the Michigan state legislature into a “MAGA operation.”
Yes, you read that right.
National Republicans and outside groups have made it clear that they’re heavily invested in Michigan. Not only are the Governor, Attorney General, and Secretary of State’s races on their list of targets, but so are the races up and down the ballot, including U.S. House and the state legislature.
Elissa is in the state’s *most competitive* House race. and with the end of the fiscal quarter (where all candidates are federally required to report how much money they’ve raised) coming up on March 31, now is an extremely important time to show our strength. And luckily, we know just how to do that – with an outpouring of grassroots support.
Will you chip in to help keep Michigan blue today? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq12022?refcode=email20220329&amount=28]

Team Slotkin
Team,
We wanted to make sure you saw: Donald Trump is heading back to Michigan.
secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq12022?refcode=email20220329&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq12022?refcode=email20220329&amount=28]
This will be his first stop in the state since he lost in 2020 — he’s coming in support of two statewide Republican candidates, one of whom has peddled conspiracy theories about voter fraud. His visit has him stopping in Macomb county in suburban Detroit, and it will be interesting to see which other GOP politicians show up to greet the former president.
Trump’s trip is a good reminder that House candidates won’t be the only thing on Michiganders’ ballots on Election Day . Our top statewide elected officials – the Governor, Attorney General, and Secretary of State – are on the ‘top of the ticket’. Right now, these seats are all held by Democrats, and Republicans are eager to flip them as they look toward the next Presidential election in 2024.
This reaffirms what we already know: all eyes will be on Michigan this November, because it’s often the canary in the coal mine for political trends. It also reaffirms that Elissa is going to need a lot of support as she runs in the most competitive House race in Michigan — and one of the most competitive in the entire country. She is ready and willing to do her part, but we’d love your help to push us forward as we approach our March 31 fundraising deadline.
Will you chip in today to fight back against national [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq12022?refcode=email20220326&amount=28] Republicans looking to flip Michigan from blue to red? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq12022?refcode=email20220329&amount=28]

| **Fellow Champions of Democracy,**

When Donald Trump claimed he was cheated out of the election he lost fairly, Texas Republicans took the chance to drag Texas back to the 1950s and institute a new Jim Crow. All of a sudden, Texas was becoming less white, more educated, and less likely to grant the Texas GOP an eternal majority. Unfortunately for us Texans, they did not take a changing state as an opportunity to change their party platform to fit their new constituents.

_**[No. Instead, they changed the rules.](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=e9948be594&e=4712f71bea)**_

[_**More than ever, voters in Texans need somebody to champion their rights and freedoms guaranteed to them as Americans. I will be that champion. Contribute $5 to overcome the GOP's extremist agenda for America. **_](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=7c6f8a827a&e=4712f71bea)

subject: Not leaving anyone behind

body:
It’s critical that we meet our end-of-quarter goal. With a $3.00 donation you can help us get there.
#
**We’re officially 30 days away from the start of early voting in North Carolina.**
It’s crunch time — and it’s absolutely critical that we don’t fall behind on our fundraising. **_[Can you donate $3 or more today to help us ramp up our fundraising in the 30 days we have until early voting starts?](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/47595?t=1&akid=1041%2E3698%2EkjNgYy)_**
We have an ambitious online**end-of-quarter goal of $40,000** because we’re up against a far-right Republican and moderate Democrat who have corporate money lining their pockets.
On the other hand, we’re running this race the right way — without a dime of corporate, super PAC, or fossil fuel money. But that means that we have to work 10x harder to raise just as much.
This campaign will be won door by door, county by county, and from face to face conversations. Erica has already visited all 19 counties across our district and our campaign has even knocked on doors in neighborhoods that vote Republican.
That’s because our movement for North Carolina is about _not leaving anyone behind_. We’re committed to changing hearts and minds and advocating for progressive policies that will help working families across NC-01 and the entire state of North Carolina.
[**_But we must have the resources to do so._**](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/47595?t=2&akid=1041%2E3698%2EkjNgYy)[**_Will you donate just $3 today to help us reach voters and send Erica to Congress?_**](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/47595?t=3&akid=1041%2E3698%2EkjNgYy)
**[Donate $3](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/47601?refcode=em20220329-1041&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=1041%2E3698%2EkjNgYy)**
**You can be sure the next 30 days will determine our success in the primary election — and what we raise before midnight on Thursday will have a direct impact on our campaign budget.** And that’s why we’re counting on your support to help us approach primary election day strong, and build a campaign that can win in November
Together,
Team Erica Smith
Erica Smith is a single mother, educator, and three-term state senator, who grew up on her family farm and spent her life fighting for rural Eastern North Carolina. Now, she’s running to represent NC-01 — _her home district_ – in Congress, where she’ll fight for economic justice and workers’ rights, universal healthcare, voting rights, and more. **[Add a donation to help us protect this competitive, open U.S. House seat and give power back to working people »](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/47601?refcode=em20220329-1041-box&%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=23&akid=1041%2E3698%2EkjNgYy)** **[Donate](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/47601?refcode=em20220329-1041-box&%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=24&akid=1041%2E3698%2EkjNgYy)**

Madison Cawthorn has failed us as our Congressman. Leaders don’t leave – when the going gets tough, leaders show up and commit. Not Madison Cawthorn.
Instead, he abandoned his constituents and spent months campaigning in another district only to return to NC-11 when it benefited him politically.
This dereliction of duty is nothing new for Cawthorn. In the past year that he’s been in Congress, none of the 30 bills he sponsored earned so much as a hearing because they have been political stunts. And he’s voted against legislation that is bringing real results to working families in our district – like broadband, the child tax credit, and support for our schools.
**It’s time to elect someone who actually cares about our families and our future. Our campaign is the best opportunity we have to defeat Cawthorn once and for all.**
I know there’s a path forward for all of us together, but I need your help. We need to reach our end-of-quarter goal so we can bring our vision of love, hope, and empathy to every corner of the district.

**Today, the House Oversight Committee is holding a Medicare for All hearing — the first since the pandemic began and exposed just how much harm our for-profit healthcare system has done to families and our economy.**
As an allied health professional, Melanie has seen our broken healthcare system up close, and she knows all the insidious ways it harms our families physically and financially. We’re looking forward to seeing what comes out of the hearings, and in particular how insurance executives will attempt to justify practices that treat patients as dollar signs on a spreadsheet instead of human beings whose lives depend on receiving care.
In the meantime, here are 6 quick things you should know about Medicare for All:
__
1. _It would save the lives of an estimated 68,000 Americans each year._
2. _It would guarantee high-quality healthcare for everyone, no exceptions; including dental, vision, mental health, hearing aids, reproductive care, long-term care and substance abuse treatment._
3. _It would save an estimated $458 billion per year compared to our current healthcare system, and $650 billion per year compared to the proposed Public Option._
4. _It would create 2.3 million new healthcare jobs and up to 17 million jobs providing long-term care._
5. _You can see the doctors you want, not just the ones your insurance company allows you to see._
6. _It would save businesses money by removing the financial burden of providing healthcare for their employees._

__
---
If some of this sounds hard to believe, and contrary to what you might’ve heard, that’s because immensely rich and powerful lobbyists have spent over _$10 billion in the last 23 years_ buying politicians and spreading misinformation to keep our for-profit healthcare system broken and profitable at the expense of our families.
**Enough is enough. It’s time to elect unbought representatives like Melanie who will fight with everything they’ve got to make healthcare a basic human right in this country.**

clean_body: | | | | Healthcare is a human right, Peter Willis. Full stop. Not only is universal healthcare with Medicare for All morally and fiscally responsible, but it has overwhelming support from 69% of voters on both sides of the aisle. So what’s holding us back from creating the solutions we need? Only Congress and the lobbyists cutting them checks.** Today, the House Oversight Committee is holding a Medicare for All hearing — the first since the pandemic began and exposed just how much harm our for-profit healthcare system has done to families and our economy. As an allied health professional, Melanie has seen our broken healthcare system up close, and she knows all the insidious ways it harms our families physically and financially. We’re looking forward to seeing what comes out of the hearings, and in particular how insurance executives will attempt to justify practices that treat patients as dollar signs on a spreadsheet instead of human beings whose lives depend on receiving care. In the meantime, here are 6 quick things you should know about Medicare for All: 1. It would save the lives of an estimated 68,000 Americans each year. 2. It would guarantee high-quality healthcare for everyone, no exceptions; including dental, vision, mental health, hearing aids, reproductive care, long-term care and substance abuse treatment. 3. It would save an estimated $458 billion per year compared to our current healthcare system, and $650 billion per year compared to the proposed Public Option. 4. It would create 2.3 million new healthcare jobs and up to 17 million jobs providing long-term care. 5. You can see the doctors you want, not just the ones your insurance company allows you to see. 6. It would save businesses money by removing the financial burden of providing healthcare for their employees. If some of this sounds hard to believe, and contrary to what you might’ve heard, that’s because immensely rich and powerful lobbyists have spent over $10 billion in the last 23 years buying politicians and spreading misinformation to keep our for-profit healthcare system broken and profitable at the expense of our families. Enough is enough. It’s time to elect unbought representatives like Melanie who will fight with everything they’ve got to make healthcare a basic human right in this country. Hi Peter, I've just published a new blog post: [Can't Make It Up](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=Bjc8XUdeJ9yV6eR3mI9Z6HRd5urWv8u8i-Pa-jQzioqOS1sxqnGK4geeOQ5U5zbbOiu2fAatgOA_8O_R1SCYlA&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=mar29_final&n=1) One of the most radical bills in California history is set for a vote tomorrow. AB 1993 forces every business to mandate the COVID vaccine for workers. But first, about yesterday. The Supermajority finally allowed a hearing on my bill to suspend the gas tax. I knew something was up, as I was only notified two hours in advance; usually you get two weeks’ notice. Still, I showed up and presented AB 1638. They not only proceeded to vote against it, but used the occasion to turn the bill into a massive tax _increase_. As James Gallagher put it, “you can’t make this stuff up.” By hijacking my bill, the Chair of the committee thought she’d come up with a clever way to raise taxes without having to take responsibility. Instead, she suffered one of the most humiliating moments at our Capitol in recent memory. The proposed tax was so odious the Chair refused to put her name on it, even as she rammed it through. [You can watch](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=YqgukYA3Mrlri-dqG7I8ToaN_3bChVRO5Gq5CDF2geTo3guEDLd3hp82lK_YFZdXJIbyi-jUz1wnNx3OncAzPw&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=mar29_final&n=2) the reaction from the packed committee room as she fall apart during my questioning. The net result for the Supermajority was not just egg on their face but a huge self-inflicted wound. They brought more attention to the gas tax issue while appearing cartoonishly out-of-touch and heightening the outrage of countless Californians. That is the twisted prelude to tomorrow's vote on AB 1993. Also being heard: a bill to defund police for not enforcing mask mandates. Details on how to participate are [here](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=Bjc8XUdeJ9yV6eR3mI9Z6HRd5urWv8u8i-Pa-jQziorUkdRNXYPldH1D2eniqoDLo0e_4VGeODVFzVFdqbEOaw&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=mar29_final&n=3). I believe we can kill these bills, and tomorrow is our first chance. [Support our campaign before Thursday’s crucial deadline](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=09K6E4GvoPozZ73mzf50y5etLj1_9wCfyRoQ3wvVmv-GOhHPWzgYbh54Gph7Pyuk3g2mp41Qa8XyLKk0CnWqFcPhfo-70bh2d9FGRmWv-G172QGsW76cwQP_qMTr_tK1&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=mar29_final&n=4) Kevin Kiley

| | Dear ,
We have so little time left and so much to do!

**_[We are just days away from the end of the month, and we need to raise an additional $26,450 to hit our end of quarter goal.](https://votefinchem.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a653829701c13e4a704cb19bf&id=d5102ccc9b&e=44b8c466b0)_**

I must have MISSED your contribution.

This is Mark Finchem. I am running for Secretary of State in Arizona and I’m really worried. I thought we were on track to hit our fundraising goal this month.

_[But we’re not.](https://votefinchem.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a653829701c13e4a704cb19bf&id=aa738e0191&e=44b8c466b0)_

_Right now, we’re on track to be right about a day late and a dollar short._

**_[I am just 2 days from the deadline of 3/31, and I am about $26,450 short.](https://votefinchem.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a653829701c13e4a704cb19bf&id=fb7b4e97f3&e=44b8c466b0)_**

This is unacceptable and if we don’t hit the deadline by the end of the month, these are losing numbers. It seems every end of quarter is like this, and every end of quarter I lose sleep, and then at the last minute you convince me I was wrong by helping us barely reach our goal at the last minute.

**But, folks, this is election integrity we are talking about. This isn’t any normal election, this is one of the hottest, most watched elections in the nation, why are we settling for last minute goal-reaching?**

_[We shouldn’t be. We need to crush this goal. Help me reach the end of quarter goal TONIGHT with a rush donation of $25, $50, or $100!](https://votefinchem.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a653829701c13e4a704cb19bf&id=9c15c746bb&e=44b8c466b0)_

I will personally be reviewing the list of everyone who donates today from this email. I want to see who the real patriots are who can stand up for Election Integrity in the eleventh hour. [Will I see your name on that list?](https://votefinchem.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a653829701c13e4a704cb19bf&id=36ea642657&e=44b8c466b0)

---
[](https://u1584542.ct.sendgrid.net/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953yRkW_Sw2xr1MvIXEt6jooTbMnsVYqhUO8Xwt4ORz78ORT8Pt3SALA3pMGVDypeKbyy2kgsjsCmnmy8k7FgsqB6wuCJ9K2SYervuUQSBWz0O6-eElc5v5iLtRM3tW5Yplyv9Ad3GEz2ZVjgzIZS4d36x2qxEPK9nH08ek9SqEEzqBlHBQDHx8e6aTRcWiAH5tcmRygPDW08ZS-sg6cYzSquTRCB-pyYMo0ohf5-QaaU002qTlAPqeRXTD5YtzICYrhaTooRIQWpm03hCIFvz_ZgvhhID2u8TP4OCn89CirjQ5T6dHd9AaW0kvNzePgzTZMwscvoDMkNZnYeskrzBg3gAr6xSacRvAf_03r6s7XnZe6BZUXL3kafJnzQcO0LQVdrhqQgKnR0Xzf6ZF_G73nn/3kr/V1zEmEu7QV-lx8DEWzCcxg/h0/QrcAPnAVjcgEE_ws1PqafSGk5HsD4SpKRGttKNLpTzw)
| | Dear Peter, **** America’s economic struggles are revealing themselves today in many ways: supply chain challenges, inflation in the prices of everything from gasoline to education, and shortages of critical goods including commodities and food products. These are the signs of policy failures, and Washington’s inability to respond to changing circumstances. [**Can you send me to Congress to serve as a messenger for the future, and an advocate for new policies that serve working families, instead of billionaires and the corporations in which they invest?**](https://u1584542.ct.sendgrid.net/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTCxhAMhTRXK4t_BbI_sQ5MI_xXZhQhjlUEHCuPg9SRhG-wuero40s23pGoz63FqaGo5_j_yebetHhR2J_WjCnnQgkCyhMln0XCd1OwfbrqSjaue7LlLUy0R6oOdIZe9b8PstYMFXwjJJo1H13g_OkFn0L2A_33ftHrTSb4cF4Hay9tMT3-OcKXvy1-XMST8H8QkhMDd9OvIbNad8CIobnzDwFlRn_OxkeLlllV11ehklMTVP3D5smSle8OoPxQprmTdQ4O6feWuohdeR6ex1SQZD_ax_pbkNoCtTxMjejY_dPafeJRoG4aKe9RDBf6-DSNcj1Y0-ZCs7j7wgsB-SimcQK_d7xFJr53Smi2auMzNZ/3kr/V1zEmEu7QV-lx8DEWzCcxg/h1/xokjGeGyRE8nnb3XAYc5oEIL1KPDhxoonakBw8ZDRlE) The failures in Washington are driving more than just crises impacting our aggregate economy. Each of the challenges that we confront together as Americans also impact each of us as individuals, and members of families and communities. And across America’s many communities, the economic crisis is driving ever wider the profound disparities in wealth and income that have already grown to world-historic proportions. No campaign embodies that disparity more than ours. I’m an immigrant who owns no property, challenging an intergenerational oligarch worth over $200 million. [**Can you help us level the playing field? I’m challenging the most powerful member of a Congress of millionaires—not because I have the resources to remove her, but because I have the record to prove that I’ll make better decisions if my neighbors have the independence to demand an alternative.**](https://u1584542.ct.sendgrid.net/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTCxhAMhTRXK4t_BbI_sQ5MI_xXZhQhjlUEHCuPg9SRhG-wuero40s23pGoz63FqaGnzGuN9lb2waQ-bPTrCZgTXQ9gLQio7NiNxXhEsuZp5Nkv5aJab4Aqvf_RTNQPaK6JATVUuXyWZNAGOwzj56_jt9BbwkPliIwwJ1diWcRDIe2E_yq5oZFP0TtE3OktAX7ILByNgaIvJ5GRMAWgR5W4Yzm7BLY3Qb2Jtb72Q5SR37jKmq0oM9kWOxLhB17O7qmvZsRrnYs_sAEaBSWU0ZPw3GK1AggpNSVcDGuAEaLN5K2FX_KG1Pc2c_osagVYbXcHqTO2-5nbHnT6BNUk-BrVOmoWGdOiPJIR5srXvODfyd/3kr/V1zEmEu7QV-lx8DEWzCcxg/h2/N8RqaFP0WHEg4nD5XVLW0FzDVCxWxkBIfZofsym924k) During this challenging time, we’re all tightening our belts. Our campaign is no stranger to that dynamic: due largely to establishment character assassination, in addition to challenges confronting the broader economy and working class on whose support we've relied, we’re operating with a fraction of the budget that fueled our 2020 campaign, when we won 81,000 votes. Yet we’re reaching a wider community of voters and volunteers than ever before. And—having roughly doubled our vote count between each of the elections in which I’ve participated since entering politics in 2018—we’re ready to expand on that base to liberate San Francisco’s voice in Washington. [**We’re working hard to hire a team with the skills necessary to coordinate our growing community of volunteers, identify the voters necessary to win the race, and bring our message to voters who haven’t heard about their choices. Peter,

I’ve been fighting for you and for the truth since I first was elected to Congress in November 2006. Since then, the voters of Ohio’s 4th Congressional District have continued to put their faith in me and have sent me back for two-year stints ever since.

I have never - and will never - take a single vote for granted. I will continue to work hard for every single vote; I’ve watched a lot of people lose their jobs because they forget who they report to; the American people.

**I will never take the position I currently hold for granted**.

For as long as the folks I represent continue putting their faith in me, **I’ll keep fighting every single day to make America a better version of itself.**

I’ll work to hold the mainstream media accountable.
I’ll work to make sure you have all of the information YOU need when you go vote.

I’ll work to make sure Democrats in positions of power are held accountable for their lies to the American people; NO Representative should be out for personal gain when serving the American people in an ELECTED office.

But first, I have to win reelection. **[My primary on May 3rd is fast approaching and today I’m reaching out to ask if you’ll endorse me for re-election](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=3496c16fa0ab42d8addd7a9becd3b40a&_e=6UiUd1pjcZG7Ph0NIcoCwSHpkYehmbi2GESr6Vq73Ob1mlvHI831sbOq5HXGxddVIJKOM_FMwUbcVcyQevjtyNl891XGO1nQYOSV9skp68BE4kwR-wJnt7J7RwwXtO45lDV2mfG7YLpZHSSzzHL8ZBdCrIbnCBwlUEZ0jUeCAoAECJwKgJXrdcR-B4JY600exL5BgseTV_XYldfLBnGDd9rF0DpfJZJwCxr_kt7S20bLJitnbHehXDT2DsxUtOjV9czwYvj2c7Cozal3GbtcahejHfFFdGpYs_YvGKD-9TENcnoWb-eElKyNiHMKWMpf--m0uXRMAvWcFx04nZax90eYmrh3Kwc7xJuQ-8hGNIk-wSfE6P2w73j35Rc9yBIP2Y5t4c6Ob9T9294pMJCWl8NQihheazjOcqun5Oa2-ZX7J3Bew8PsWeAuNw2qcgw-F4DBMACQYMJRRgEiZomzFDoyKx-IAQeq2ZQx-G5znvCUv5CtNH7UQJ435wtoRQ-KSnXXwSKpIRY8IyQ4JzgVJxWpVPX5ykouqy-PO5N5rC4%3D)**.

I’ll only be able to continue fighting on your behalf for as long as I’m in Congress, **[which is why I’m asking for your support today.](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=3496c16fa0ab42d8addd7a9becd3b40a&_e=6UiUd1pjcZG7Ph0NIcoCwSHpkYehmbi2GESr6Vq73Ob1mlvHI831sbOq5HXGxddVIJKOM_FMwUbcVcyQevjtyNl891XGO1nQYOSV9skp68BE4kwR-wJnt7J7RwwXtO45lDV2mfG7YLpZHSSzzHL8ZBdCrIbnCBwlUEZ0jUeCAoAECJwKgJXrdcR-B4JY600exL5BgseTV_XYldfLBnGDd9rF0DpfJZJwCxr_kt7S20bLJitnbHehXDT2DsxUtOjV9czwYvj2c7Cozal3GbtcahejHfFFdGpYs_YvGKD-9TENcnoWb-eElKyNiHMKWMpf--m0uXRMAvWcFx04nZax97zaKHoXnwuDJmvYhiuynquQTr2ktu9eLh9PqXmOB-DRBQjSMTuj0XF3_qUykY1eoglkD885H2xofoexfT_EUFsq81tlD6ogXqEAPvZ-py6IYqYZwdnOGY2Q-Jm0NR584fk0Sz6tmdwpVVPf57cnshXIiBLLPZXUj7ZmBKkOkx8BDdIhEQNXxb2x8e1HNOMMNrGnXN25FRiXyjrcRYD70Tw%3D)** It’s imperative we have strong conservative voices who are willing to speak up for the truth. We’ve got so much work to do in the remaining three years Joe Biden has in the White House.

Biden and his people have no idea what they’re doing and it’s going to take a herculean effort on the part of House Republicans to keep them from ruining our country; to keep Big Tech and big media from colluding to keep the truth about this White House -- and the people at the helm – from the**American people**.

Jim Jordan

I will continue to work hard for every single vote; I’ve watched a lot of people lose their jobs because they forget who they report to; the American people. I will never take the position I currently hold for granted. For as long as the folks I represent continue putting their faith in me, I’ll keep fighting every single day to make America a better version of itself. I’ll work to hold the mainstream media accountable. I’ll work to make sure you have all of the information YOU need when you go vote. I’ll work to make sure Democrats in positions of power are held accountable for their lies to the American people; NO Representative should be out for personal gain when serving the American people in an ELECTED office. But first, I have to win reelection. . I’ll only be able to continue fighting on your behalf for as long as I’m in Congress, It’s imperative we have strong conservative voices who are willing to speak up for the truth. I assure you that I’m worthy of your support and . We’ve got so much work to do in the remaining three years Joe Biden has in the White House. Biden and his people have no idea what they’re doing and it’s going to take a herculean effort on the part of House Republicans to keep them from ruining our country; to keep Big Tech and big media from colluding to keep the truth about this White House -- and the people at the helm – from theAmerican people. | | Peter, It is already springtime, a welcome time of year in Michigan. It is also the heating up of the election season. Andy is in a challenging primary. So this is a personal appeal from me. **I believe deeply that Andy has shown himself to be one of the very effective voices in Congress on many key issues.** They range from good jobs, a decent minimum wage for all workers, adequate health care for all our citizens, equal opportunities, a woman’s right to choose, key environmental issues, and human rights here and abroad — a leader on all of these issues and early on in support of Ukraine’s fight against Russia’s horrendous invasion. Andy has received a wide swath of endorsements from groups on these issues. But he is facing an opponent who has received large sums in opposition to his legislation in support of a two-state solution between Israel and Palestine. subject: From Alexandria

body:
Alexandria led a big rally this past weekend. Here’s what she had to say →
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220329-2904-header&t=1&akid=2904%2E2526796%2E8WDrH5)
For the last several weeks, Team AOC has been out on the streets talking to voters across the district about our upcoming primary election and introducing new NY-14 constituents to AOC’s platform.
**Alexandria joined organizers, volunteers, and community members at two rallies this past weekend to talk about the importance of community organizing. Here’s what she had to say:**
_“We’re collecting signatures to get on the ballot, but what this is really about is about knocking on our neighbor’s doors, or talking to people outside the bodega, bank, or subway station._
_**The reason why that’s important is because strong communities talk to each other.** We say, “Hey man what’s up — let me tell you something that we really need.”_
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220329?refcode=em20220329-2904-P_OTH_ANO_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&refcode2=2904_2526796_8WDrH5&akid=2904%2E2526796%2E8WDrH5)
_“Today is about collecting signatures, but tomorrow you may be knocking on your neighbor’s door asking them to join a tenants’ union. Or the day after that, it may be about organizing to make sure that we fight for more resources for our schools._
_The day after that, it might be because, like what happened right after COVID — knocking on doors to figure out where our seniors were and see if we could get the young people to go to the grocery store for them so they didn’t have to be exposed to needless risk._
_**That’s community, you don’t even need to pass a law to do that.**_
_But these types of practices and becoming a place where we’re used to engaging in that, is how we build a better, stronger community that can get what we need._
_This is a baby step, this is a practice in doing that._
_Think of this as just one of many steps necessary to really improve all of our lives._
_Let’s get to it.”_
Alexandria’s right. Community organizing is how our movement stopped the NRG fracked gas plant from being built in the backyards of Queens residents; it’s how we educated folks on the importance of filling out the census and saved New York a congressional seat; and it’s how we raised millions of dollars for relief when disaster hit our communities — from The Bronx to Texas.
That’s what this movement is about: bringing together the broader community to make the change we desperately need a reality. From the streets to the halls of power.
And we’re doing it one door at a time.
Thank you for being a part of this team,
Team AOC

name: Adam Schiff
subject: This is an email about my Jewish faith
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR CONGRESS
body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=144%2E5257348%2EfiTRMb ]Adam Schiff for Congress

Dear Derek —

I was recently visiting with my 94-year old father (his name is Ed, and he
lives in sunny Boca Raton, so he is known as BocaEddy) and he reminded me
about a photo that — well I just had to share it with you.

Here you go. Me at 13, in all my “glory” at my Bar Mitzvah:

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mar2022_abs_em?refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_IN_20220329_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&refcode2=144_5257348_fiTRMb&akid=144%2E5257348%2EfiTRMb ][IMG]

I’ll admit, it’s easy to chuckle at this photo – the classic 1970s bow
tie, the braces, the yarmulke, the looks – but it is also an opportunity
to tell you a little about how I approach my faith.

Throughout my career in public service, I’ve thought a lot about the
Jewish tradition of “Tikkun Olam,” or repairing the world. And over the
last few years, there has been a lot that was broken, and a lot to fix.
It’s been my cause.

Before I go any further, and while I still have your attention, I have to
ask – [ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mar2022_abs_em?refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_IN_20220329_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&refcode2=144_5257348_fiTRMb&akid=144%2E5257348%2EfiTRMb ]will you click this link and pitch in a few dollars to my
campaign? If you are not ready yet or need more convincing, please read
on. I have lots to share and more to say. I think you’ll like it.

I want to take you back to 1973. Our family moved around a lot because my
father was in the “schmata” business. He worked as a regional manager for
a men’s clothing company, named Farrah.

We moved from Massachusetts where I was born, lived a few years in
Arizona, and ended up in the Bay Area. It was there where my dad got out
of the clothing business and bought a lumber yard, where I worked during
the summers. There’s nothing like hauling sheets of plywood and roofing,
and shoveling concrete to make you want to go to graduate school.

This photo was taken when my family was a member of Temple Isaiah in
Lafayette, California, a reform synagogue we joined after moving to the
Bay Area. And it came after months of practicing for my Bar Mitzvah. I
even taped my practice sessions on our tape recorder (I have a copy of
that tape somewhere, believe it or not.)

While the Hebrew language skills I quickly acquired were just as quickly
lost, the lessons that my faith taught me endure and guide me to this day.

In fact, my favorite passage comes from Micah: What is required of us, but
to do justice, love mercy, and walk humbly with thy God.

These principles have guided my work in Congress. They have led me to
pursue criminal justice reform, to make housing the homeless a key
priority, to attack discrimination, and to ensure the rule of law is
applied equally. They have also guided my path as I held accountable and
stood up to the most unscrupulous man to ever occupy the Oval Office.

And they guide me in the fight we face today: repairing and building back
our democracy so that we leave it better for my children and yours.

That’s why I put everything I have into my work in Congress and for the
cause of our democracy. It’s the first thing I think about when I wake up
in the morning, and I don’t rest until I’ve done all I can for the day.

continue that work by chipping in $10 to my re-election campaign.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

Me at 13, in all my “glory” at my Bar Mitzvah: [ ][IMG] I’ll admit, it’s easy to chuckle at this photo – the classic 1970s bow tie, the braces, the yarmulke, the looks – but it is also an opportunity to tell you a little about how I approach my faith. Throughout my career in public service, I’ve thought a lot about the Jewish tradition of “Tikkun Olam,” or repairing the world. And over the last few years, there has been a lot that was broken, and a lot to fix. It’s been my cause. Before I go any further, and while I still have your attention, I have to ask – [ ]will you click this link and pitch in a few dollars to my campaign? If you are not ready yet or need more convincing, please read on. I have lots to share and more to say. I think you’ll like it. I want to take you back to 1973. Our family moved around a lot because my father was in the “schmata” business. He worked as a regional manager for a men’s clothing company, named Farrah. We moved from Massachusetts where I was born, lived a few years in Arizona, and ended up in the Bay Area. It was there where my dad got out of the clothing business and bought a lumber yard, where I worked during the summers. There’s nothing like hauling sheets of plywood and roofing, and shoveling concrete to make you want to go to graduate school. This photo was taken when my family was a member of Temple Isaiah in Lafayette, California, a reform synagogue we joined after moving to the Bay Area. And it came after months of practicing for my Bar Mitzvah. I even taped my practice sessions on our tape recorder (I have a copy of that tape somewhere, believe it or not.) While the Hebrew language skills I quickly acquired were just as quickly lost, the lessons that my faith taught me endure and guide me to this day. In fact, my favorite passage comes from Micah: What is required of us, but to do justice, love mercy, and walk humbly with thy God. These principles have guided my work in Congress. They have led me to pursue criminal justice reform, to make housing the homeless a key priority, to attack discrimination, and to ensure the rule of law is applied equally. They have also guided my path as I held accountable and stood up to the most unscrupulous man to ever occupy the Oval Office. And they guide me in the fight we face today: repairing and building back our democracy so that we leave it better for my children and yours. That’s why I put everything I have into my work in Congress and for the cause of our democracy. It’s the first thing I think about when I wake up in the morning, and I don’t rest until I’ve done all I can for the day. [ ]If these priorities resonate with you, I’m asking for your help to continue that work by chipping in $10 to my re-election campaign. **Friends: **
This week we discuss the nature and purpose of limited government, and the distribution of powers between the Federal Government and the States as put forth by the Tenth Amendment. Understanding this simple concept is key to reigning in the burgeoning growth of the federal bureaucracy and putting a halt to government overreach.

**VOTE FOR ALAN MAY 24th in the Republican Primary! Early Voting begins May 2nd!**

---
| **This week in Congress:** Last week the **Senate Judiciary Committee** confirmation hearing of Supreme Court nominee, Ketanji Brown Jackson, revealed several concerning issues.
* Jackson declined to define what a “woman” is, instead she stated she is “not a biologist”
* She is a proponent of critical race theory
* Jackson has shown a peculiar juridical soft spot for some of society’s very worst offenders—pedophiles and child pornographers
* She has questioned the wisdom of making child pornography convicts register as sex offenders
* She is supported by many of the left’s foremost lobby groups—among them the Human Rights Campaign, NARAL Pro-Choice America, Planned Parenthood, and the George Soros-funded Open Society Policy Center

Judge Jackson should not be confirmed to serve on the highest court in our nation. She has illustrated throughout her career she does not support the Constitution, and has not advocated for the protection of our children.

---
| **Alan on the Issues:** **Tenth Amendment**
“The powers not delegated to the United States by the Constitution, nor prohibited by it to the States, are reserved to the States respectively, or to the people.” - The Tenth Amendment to the U.S. Constitution

**Key Takeaways:**
* The powers of the federal government of the United States are constitutionally limited
* The Tenth Amendment enumerates specific powers granted to the federal government
* All rights not granted to the federal government belong to the States, or to the people
* This constitutional balance of power was unsettled during the New Deal and World War II
* Federal overreach and regulation have reached an all-time high

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Janice for Idaho, Piercy Robinson Treasurer [unsubscribe](https://janicemcgeachin
body:
Numerous conservative legislative proposals failed to become law or even receive a hearing. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/janicemcgeachin/03-29-22?e=823fa8e224)
---
| | [ ](https://janicemcgeachin.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75545c0bb4a66af3c4692bc0e&id=ab4e9df15f&e=823fa8e224)
---
| | Dear Friends,
---
| The week got off to a great start with an interview with former White House Correspondent Emerald Robinson, where we discussed issues important to Idaho. [**Click Here**](https://janicemcgeachin.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75545c0bb4a66af3c4692bc0e&id=22a24ef76d&e=823fa8e224) to watch it. On March 23rd, I attended a wonderful Meet & Greet for Dorothy Moon, candidate for Secretary of State. The picture below was taken at this event.
---
|
---
|
## Legislative Session Update
As the Legislative Session comes to a close, there are many things to consider, including the numerous conservative proposals that failed to become law or — in many cases — even be given a hearing. We did get a small income tax reduction but no meaningful property tax relief, no removal of the sales tax on groceries, and no reduction or suspension of the gas tax. [House Bill 492](https://janicemcgeachin.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75545c0bb4a66af3c4692bc0e&id=0de9b91875&e=823fa8e224) would have cut Idaho's gas tax in half for two years, but the bill was not given a hearing. One of the few good bills that did pass this session was the Coronavirus Pause Act ([S1381](https://janicemcgeachin.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75545c0bb4a66af3c4692bc0e&id=0640b88cd2&e=823fa8e224)), which, although far from the best bill introduced on the subject, would have taken some small steps to temporarily protect most Idahoans from vaccine mandates. Unfortunately, it would not protect the rights of Idahoans employed in the health care industry. Despite passing both the House and Senate by significant majorities, **Gov. Little vetoed the bill!** Once again, Brad is siding with IACI and the crony corporations against the Idaho people, vetoing even these minor limitations on vaccine mandates. **The Senate and the House could vote to override this veto and protect individual liberty, but will they? Perhaps if they hear from enough constituents demanding a veto override, they will.** Among those bills that did not pass both chambers are two bills relating to limiting mask mandates passed the House ([H0631](https://janicemcgeachin.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75545c0bb4a66af3c4692bc0e&id=98c1f056a9&e=823fa8e224), [H0734](https://janicemcgeachin.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75545c0bb4a66af3c4692bc0e&id=0d0f9e3335&e=823fa8e224)) but neither were given a hearing in the Senate. There was a bill to defend religious liberty that protected religious exemptions from a coronavirus vaccine requirement ([H0719](https://janicemcgeachin.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75545c0bb4a66af3c4692bc0e&id=765b7d8ac9&e=823fa8e224)). It passed the House but was denied a hearing in the Senate. A bill to protect children against abusive medical procedures also passed the House ([H0675](https://janicemcgeachin.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75545c0bb4a66af3c4692bc0e&id=3a04876136&e=823fa8e224)) but it too was denied a hearing in the Senate. There was a bill to protect children from obscene materials in public schools and libraries ([H0666](https://janicemcgeachin.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75545c0bb4a66af3c4692bc0e&id=021ccc7394&e=823fa8e224)). It passed the House, but (you guessed it) it was denied a hearing in the Senate. It was this last bill that ended up spilling over into a debate over the appropriations bill for the Commission for Libraries. Five such bills were introduced in total with two being voted down on the House floor and the final one ([H0827](https://janicemcgeachin.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75545c0bb4a66af3c4692bc0e&id=1a638be641&e=823fa8e224)) passing but still with considerable opposition. Although most parents probably don't realize it, the state's laws that prohibit disseminating pornography and other obscene materials to children don't apply to libraries, schools, or colleges and universities. These entities are given a special exemption from the law that stores, theaters, and other venues must follow. Both the House and Senate have expressed intentions to set up interim working groups to study the issue, but we are unlikely to see any meaningful action taken to protect our children until at least the next session in 2023. Friend,

While I’m not myself up for reelection for a number of years, I’m absolutely dedicated to helping Republicans win back both the Senate majority and the majority in the U.S. House.

When I come across promising candidates for office, I make a concerted effort to do everything I personally can to help them succeed. That’s why today I’m excited to endorse Mr. Rod Dorilás for Congress.

**Rod’s Dorilás’ story is quintessentially American.** His Haitian immigrant parents came to the United States without a penny to their name; to make a living they picked crops in South Florida. With hard work and a lot of perseverance, they found their own American Dream and became small business owners. And less than forty years after first arriving in the United States, their son – Rod – had the distinct honor of serving the president of the United States.

I’m proud to support the son of entrepreneurial immigrants who built their own American Dream without the help of the government, or socialist-style handouts. **Perhaps with more dedicated public servants such as Rod Dorilás in Congress, grit, determination and personal responsibility may finally win out over the left’s mantra of “give me give me give me.”**

| _**ABOUT ROD**_

Rod Dorilás is the first-generation son of two immigrants from Haiti. His father immigrated to Florida to pick crops, and eventually his parents went on to own a small business. From a young age, his parents instilled in him the importance of hard work, integrity, and service.

At age 17, Rod enlisted in the United States Navy, serving for six years as a Petty Officer Second Class and Assistant Engagement Control Officer onboard the USS The Sullivans, stationed in Jacksonville. There, he was responsible for planning and executing the deployment of Tomahawk Land Attack Missiles on the Ballistic Missile Defense destroyer.

Upon completion of his military service, Rod attended law school at Syracuse University with the help of the G.I. Bill. After graduating, he served in President Trump's Administration in the U.S. Department of Commerce. While serving our great nation, Rod fought tirelessly to ensure that American families and businesses weren't taken advantage of by China.

Rod is a true public servant and is dedicated to serving his country and community. He wants to ensure that every American, through hard work and perseverance, can achieve the American Dream. Rod is running for Congress in South Florida to continue Trump's America First Agenda and defend our country from the Radical Left.

We can’t let up now. The FEC End-of-Quarter fundraising deadline is just days away.
